description: This Dart source file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages user authentication state, including login, logout, and KYC (Know Your Customer) completion status. It interacts with the AuthRepository for data persistence and exposes state flags and user information to other components.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider class that manages authentication state, including the current user, loading status, and methods for login, logout, and updating KYC status.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor for initializing AuthProvider with an AuthRepository instance.

methods.name: AuthProvider.bootstrap
methods.description: Static async factory method that creates an AuthProvider instance, loads user data, and prepares the provider for use.

methods.name: loading
methods.description: Getter that indicates if an authentication operation is currently in progress.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Getter that returns the current user object if authenticated.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Boolean getter indicating if a user is currently authenticated.

methods.name: isKycCompleted
methods.description: Boolean getter indicating if the current user's KYC process is completed.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Private async method that loads the current user data from the repository and updates loading state.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Async method to log in a user with email and name, updating the user state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Async method to log out the current user, clearing user state.

methods.name: markKycCompleted
methods.description: Async method to mark the user's KYC process as completed.
